  • Class
    Description
    BrowserContext
    The capability facade the browser hands an extension at BrowserExtension.onBrowserStarted(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.BrowserContext).
    BrowserExtension
    The Web Browser extension SPI.
    ExtensionBroker
    The runtime that drives BrowserExtension hooks on behalf of FxBrowser.
    ExtensionManifest
    Immutable metadata an extension publishes through BrowserExtension.manifest(): its identity, a human-readable blurb and the permissions it needs.
    ExtensionRegistry
    Discovers and tracks BrowserExtension implementations, and holds the user's enable / permission-grant decisions for each.
    ExtensionRegistry.LoadedExtension
    One discovered extension plus the user's decisions about it.
    ExtensionState
    The persisted enable/grant state of one discovered extension, serialised as one entry of extensions.json by BrowserStore.
    NavigationDecision
    An extension's verdict on a NavigationRequest: proceed, block, or proceed against a different URL.
    NavigationDecision.Action
    The three possible verdicts.
    NavigationRequest
    An immutable navigation about to happen, offered to extensions through BrowserExtension.onNavigate(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.NavigationRequest) so they may allow, block or redirect it.
    PageContext
    A loaded page, handed to extensions through BrowserExtension.onPageLoaded(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.PageContext) as the content-script injection point.
    Permission
    A capability an extension declares in its ExtensionManifest and that the user must grant (through the extension manager) before the matching hook or BrowserContext capability becomes live.
    PopupDecision
    The two possible verdicts on a PopupRequest.
    PopupRequest
    A popup (a window.open or target=_blank request) about to be opened, offered to extensions through BrowserExtension.onPopup(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.PopupRequest).
    ToolbarContribution
    A toolbar button an extension contributes through BrowserExtension.toolbarContributions().
